text:
Leah (PM): FYI kicking off a short PRD intake for a feature I'm calling 'partial-response graceful degrade' — goal is to let endpoints return a concise, validated partial response when full generation would violate latency/cost SLOs or when downstream quality falls below a threshold. Problem: some customers have workflows where a short, deterministic response is better than slow or expensive full outputs. We need clear goals, acceptance criteria, and non-goals before we scope.

Sam (Eng Runtime): +1. Can you sketch the user flows? Is this per-route config or model-level?

Leah (PM): Per-route and per-tenant config. Two flows: (1) latency-triggered partial: if P95 > target, respond with trimmed output and a metadata flag; (2) quality-triggered partial: if eval signal (reranker/quality classifier) below threshold mid-generation, cut to summary mode.

Priya (ML): For quality-triggered, we need a lightweight classifier / early-stopping signal. We can do a prefix-likelihood heuristic or a small binary head. Want to avoid extra 2-3 tok latency.

Carlos (SRE): Operational concerns: how do we report and debug trimmed outputs? Need standardized metadata in response and observability (per-route counters: partial_count, partial_rate, reason=latency|quality). Also make sure tracing shows fallback path.

Maya (Customer Success): A few enterprise customers asked for predictable degrade modes for compliance reasons — they'd prefer a short certified template than unpredictable hallucinations. They'll want opt-in and audit logs.

Sam (Eng Runtime): Implementation ideas: add strategy types to the route config: {"mode":"partial","trigger":{"type":"latency","p95_ms":150}} and {"mode":"partial","trigger":{"type":"quality","threshold":0.6}}. Runtime would attempt normal generation, monitor streaming tokens, and if trigger fires, run a trim/summarize fallback.

Leah (PM): Success metrics proposal: partial_rate <= 5% for default tiers, user-specified target; degraded_user_impact: < 2% increase in user retries; quality_delta: mean eval_score drop <= 0.05 vs full output on sampled prompts; P95 latency improvement when partial used: 30%+ for affected requests.

Priya (ML): Acceptance criteria for quality-triggered mode: (a) classifier precision >= 0.85 at recall >= 0.6 in internal eval; (b) summarizer fidelity >= 0.7 on ROUGE-like metric against full outputs; (c) end-to-end added latency <= 20ms median for the detection path.

Carlos (SRE): Non-goals: not trying to make this a full offline summarization service. Not a per-token auto-abort for every customer — only explicit route opt-in and tenant caps. Also initial rollout should be limited to hosted + dedicated; private on-prem later.

Sam (Eng Runtime): Edge cases: streaming clients expect partials vs final marker. Need stable wire contract: include header `x-redwood-partial: true` and body key `partial_reason`. And ensure chunked streaming still works (send final chunk with truncated flag).

Maya (Customer Success): From customer side, require: opt-in toggle, ability to pin fallback template, and audit entry for each partial response listing trigger and model version.

Priya (ML): We should add a small eval harness that compares partial vs full across customer prompt buckets. Suggest storing A/B samples and per-tenant gating metrics.

Carlos (SRE): Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha on canary routing for internal apps; 2) beta with 3 customers (CS will recruit); 3) general availability with telemetry and alerting. Need an alert when partial_rate spikes 3x baseline.

Leah (PM): Nice, thanks. Action items: Sam draft config schema + wire contract; Priya prototype classifier & summarizer evaluation; Carlos define observability events + alerts; Maya line up pilot customers. I'll write the intake PRD and assign owners.

ops-bot: New PRD intake created: https://redwood.internal/prd/partial-response-graceful-degrade (auto-tag: product, runtime)

Leah (PM): I'll post a short RFC link once I have the first draft — aiming EOW for the PRD sketch. Please DM if you want to add requirements or non-goals.
